Termination is restricted to captured non-baseline handles after rechecking PID, birth and complete Job membership. Every forced termination is recorded. All captured handles must exit and the exact baseline must be restored before the next command.

The outer supervisor still requires zero children after Python exit and the caller observes supervisor exit. Diagnostic success may include explicitly recorded cleanup of fixture children; it never qualifies a product release or silently permits an extra production member.
